body:
To reproduce this issue:
- get latest Quarkus `master` branch (`git clone git@github.com:quarkusio/quarkus.git`)
- `mvn clean install -DskipTests -DskipITs`
- get latest quickstarts `development` branch (`git clone git@github.com:quarkusio/quarkus-quickstarts.git && git checkout development`)
- `cd using-opentracing`
- `mvn clean install -Pnative`
- `./target/using-opentracing-1.0-SNAPSHOT-runner`
- in another shell `curl http://localhost:8080/chain`
- go back to previous shell, you should see:
```
2019-05-01 13:16:44,636 ERROR [org.jbo.exe.uncaught] (executor-thread-1) Thread Thread[executor-thread-1,5,executor] threw an uncaught exception: java.lang.ClassCastException
	at org.jboss.threads.ThreadLocalResettingRunnable$Resetter.run(Substitutions.java:60)
	at org.jboss.threads.ThreadLocalResettingRunnable.run(ThreadLocalResettingRunnable.java:34)
	at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:748)
	at org.jboss.threads.JBossThread.run(JBossThread.java:479)
	at com.oracle.svm.core.thread.JavaThreads.threadStartRoutine(JavaThreads.java:473)
	at com.oracle.svm.core.posix.thread.PosixJavaThreads.pthreadStartRoutine(PosixJavaThreads.java:193)
```
`JBossThread` inherits from a `java.lang.Thread` class that is different from the one we try to cast it to.

issue.title: opentracing - java.net.UnknownHostException in native mode, not in JVM mode
issue.body:
When Playing with https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/2218#issuecomment-488259704 reproducer via quarkus-quickstarts/using-opentracing I noticed UnknownHostException in native mode(1.0.0-rc-16), not in JVM mode

I'm at home and my hostname is set to RS, no dns around.
Of course when I update my /etc/hosts this issues goes away even for native mode.
But sometimes users don't have rights to edit /etc/hosts or they don't know they can do it.
